description: MCM QA flake registry. Tracks tests with known intermittent failure patterns. Each entry requires a root cause, reproduction rate estimate, and resolution owner.

entries.test: typography: body font on all pages
entries.root_cause: Playwright win-arm64 canvas build fails — suite cannot run. All tests in this file are blocked, not flaky by design.
entries.resolution: Resolve win-arm64 canvas/playwright build. Owner: GP.

entries.root_cause: Same as flake-001 — Playwright runtime blocked on win-arm64.
entries.resolution: Resolve win-arm64 canvas/playwright build. Owner: GP.

entries.test: shuffle produces unique orderings across seeds
entries.root_cause: SHA-256 hash collision probability is negligible but non-zero. Test uses 100 seeds; at 10! orderings the collision floor is ~0%. In practice: no failures observed.
entries.resolution: None needed. Document as acceptable probabilistic pass.

entries.root_cause: Test reads data/kai-scores-2026-02-22.json as fixture. If that file is deleted or renamed, test fails. Not intermittent — deterministic on file presence.
entries.repro_rate: 0% if file present; 100% if file removed
entries.resolution: Add fixture presence check to pre-commit guard. Owner: GF.

entries.root_cause: test writes to os.tmpdir() — concurrent test runs from two agents could collide on the temp filename. Mitigated by random suffix in filename.
entries.resolution: None needed. Random suffix + Date.now() makes collision effectively impossible.

entries.root_cause: 14 questions have undefined source_file (w2w3-001 through w2w3-005 + 9 others). Data import pipeline omits source_file for some question batches. Not intermittent.
entries.repro_rate: 100% deterministic fail until GI fixes data
entries.resolution: GI to add source_file to missing questions in questions.json. Owner: GI.

entries.test: All question standards exist in standards.json
entries.root_cause: 37 questions reference standards with combined notation (5.b & 5.c, 6.a, W2.c) not present in standards.json. Standards.json is missing multi-standard compound keys.
entries.repro_rate: 100% deterministic fail until GI/GR reconcile standards
entries.resolution: GI to add compound standard keys or GR to split into atomic standards. Owner: GI/GR.

entries.root_cause: importScores() does not wrap JSON.parse in try/catch. Corrupted localStorage string throws uncaught exception and silently fails. Known gap reported to GA via risk brief.
entries.repro_rate: 100% deterministic fail until GA adds try/catch
entries.resolution: GA to add try/catch around JSON.parse in importScores(). Owner: GA.

resolved.fix: Token renamed to --accent-blue-on-dark in shared/styles.css. Updated test to match new token.
exam.html changed template to use id=scoreBigEl. Updated test selector.

resolved.test: fetch failure shows explicit load error
resolved.fix: Stale assertion checked for 'Could not load exam:' — actual text is showLoadError pattern. Updated test.
